I apologize, but there is no character named "Jack Frost" in the movie "Santa Clause 2." The movie features Tim Allen as Scott Calvin/Santa Claus and Martin Short as Santa's elf sidekick, Rudolph.

If you are thinking of a different movie or character, please let me know and I'll be happy to help.

In Santa Clause 2, Jack Frost is played by the talented actor Ethan Hawke. His portrayal of the mischievous and cunning Jack Frost brought a unique energy to the film, as he skillfully balanced charm and menace. Ethan's performance added depth to the character, making Jack Frost a memorable and cunning adversary for Tim Allen's Santa Claus.
The character of Jack Frost in the 2002 film "The Santa Clause 2" is played by Eric Lloyd
Jack Frost is played by actor John Candy.
